title: Optimize join stage projection required set
constraints: Preserve stage projection schema order and predicate coverage
rationale: build_stage_join_projection collected required columns as lowercased strings, then lowercased every schema column again during projection construction. The resolved column indices already identify the required columns.
steps: Track required projection columns as schema indices
Preserve schema-order projection by filtering with required indices
Run focused join projection pushdown regressions and cargo check
expected_impact: Avoids repeated lowercase string allocation in join stage projection planning.
